title: M1 (a): Connected sector level skeleton — traversable greybox spine, spawn, reach-boss flow
description: First M1 'Fuga del Sector' build step. Replace the loose arenas with ONE connected, traversable level scene (greybox is fine — TileMapLayer + Terrains per godot-game-dev skill; no art investment). This is the spatial spine that will later hold the two gates (TASK-027/028) and the boss room (TASK-029). Hero starts with flight already available (DD-008/DD-011). Use the game-design + godot-game-dev skills. Keep it deterministic and testable. Set this level as the project main_scene (arena.tscn / test_level.tscn remain as sandboxes). Sprinkle a couple of existing enemies (drone/charger) along the path for the combat criterion, but the gates and boss come in later tickets — leave clearly marked placeholder spots / regions for them. Build it so reaching the boss room is detectable (an Area2D 'boss room' trigger or a named marker) for the victory flow wired in TASK-029.
acceptance_criteria: A single connected level scene exists (e.g. levels/sector_01.tscn), loads headless clean (no SCRIPT ERROR / Parse Error), and is set as the project main_scene.
The level is a connected traversable space (not separate arena rooms): the player can path from the spawn point to a designated boss-room region. Greybox geometry is acceptable.
The hero spawns with flight already available (respects DD-008/DD-011) — no movement ability is gated in this ticket.
Named/markered placeholder locations exist for the elemental-environment gate (TASK-027) and the anti-magic flight zone (TASK-028), plus a detectable boss-room trigger/marker for TASK-029.

GUT tests (tests-first) cover: the scene instances headless without error, the player spawn node resolves, and the boss-room trigger/marker is present and reachable (e.g. a path/region assertion). Full suite stays green exit 0, run multiple times (flake-aware), gdlint clean.
